Frequently Asked questions:
Placement Participation
Q: Are CMIT M.Tech (DSAI) fellows eligible to participate in campus placement drives along with other M.Tech students?
A: Yes, CMIT M.Tech fellows are permitted to participate in campus placement drives as applicable to the other academic programs of IIITNR. However, joining any company is only allowed after successful completion of the M.Tech program. Any deviation from this may invoke the bond clause.
Fellowship Eligibility
Q: Can a CMIT M.Tech fellow with a valid GATE score receive the AICTE fellowship of ₹12,500 in addition to the CMIT fellowship?
A: No. A student cannot avail of two fellowships simultaneously.
Mode of Skill Test
Q: Will the skill test be conducted online or offline?
A: The skill test will be conducted in offline mode.
Skill Test Syllabus
Q: What syllabus or content will the skill test cover?
A: Please refer to the official brochure or the program’s webpage for syllabus details.
Residential Requirement
Q: Is it mandatory for CMIT M.Tech fellows to reside on campus during the program?
A: Yes, IIIT Naya Raipur is a fully residential campus. All students are required to stay on campus.
Mid-Program Placement
Q: What if a CMIT M.Tech fellow receives a placement offer during the course of the program (on-campus or off-campus)?
A: Students may only accept such offers after completing the program. Early joining would trigger the bond clause.
Post-Program Government Opportunities
Q: Are there guaranteed government job opportunities for CMIT M.Tech fellows after program completion?
A: There is no provision of any guaranteed Government jobs. However, it is up to the prevalent norms & rules of Government of Chhattisgarh to consider or not the fellows of the program after the completion of the course.
Academic Fee Coverage
Q: Does the fellowship cover all academic fees such as tuition, registration, examination, and hostel fees?
A: The Government of Chhattisgarh sponsors only the tuition fee. Other expenses including hostel accommodation, mess, examination fees, medical insurance, SAC charges, etc., must be borne by the fellows.
Accommodation During Government Department Engagement
Q: Will accommodation be provided during government department assignments? Will hostel facilities at IIIT-NR be available if the posting is outside campus?
A: Fellows will be provided accommodation within the IIIT-NR campus throughout the duration of the program.
Equivalence with Regular M.Tech (CSE)
Q: Is the CMIT M.Tech program equivalent to the regular M.Tech in CSE?
A: Yes, the CMIT M.Tech program is academically equivalent to the regular M.Tech in CSE. Though each and every academic program has its own program structure and curriculum.

CHANDRA SHEKHAR NISHAD
Web Url: https://sites.google.com/site/csnishadiit/home?authuser=0
Brief Profile :
Dr. Chandra Shekhar Nishad is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Science, Humanities and Management (SHM). Prior to joining IIIT-NR, he was an Assistant Professor in the Department of Mathematics, School of Technology, Pandit Deendayal Energy University (PDEU) Gandhinagar, India. He has completed M.Sc. (Mathematics & Computing) from IIT Guwahati in 2009 and M.Tech. (Industrial Mathematics & Scientific Computing) from IIT Madras in 2012. He has completed his Ph.D. degree in Applied Mathematics from IIT Kharagpur under the supervision of Prof. G.P Raja Sekhar in 2019. He has received DAAD Scholarship (DAAD IIT Master Sandwich Program) for doing M.Tech. Dissertation at Technical University Darmstadt Germany in 2011. He was the batch topper in M.Tech. (Industrial Mathematics & Scientific Computing) at IIT Madras. He has published more than 20 research papers in journals and conference proceedings of international repute. Currently, he is supervising one Ph.D. student in PDEU Gandhinagar as external co-guide. He has also served as reviewer of papers/articles of many reputed international journals and conferences.

MA101C Discrete Mathematics, Autumn 2023

August 2019 - June 2023: Assistant Professor in the Department of Mathematics, School of Technology, PDEU Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
August 2012 - June 2013: Assistant Professor in the Department of Mathematics, National Institute of Technology Silchar, Assam.
September 2011 – May 2012: Guest Researcher, Institute for Nano- and Microfluidics, Centre of Smart Interfaces TU Darmstadt, Germany
July 2010-August 2011: Halftime teaching Assistant, Indian Institute of Technology Madras, Tamilnadu.
August 2009 - July 2010: Lecturer in the Department of Professional Courses, Meerut College Meerut, Uttar Pradesh.
Awards And Accolades

Recipient of International Travel Support (ITS) from SERB-DST New Delhi in June 2017 (not availed).
Selected for joint PhD programme at IITB-Monash Research Academy (IIT Bombay & Monash University Australia) in Oct 2014 (not availed).

Recipient of Prof. LVKV Sarma prize (USA) (Silver Medal) from IIT Madras (12th April 2012).

Darash Adhari
Brief Profile :
Dr. Darash Adhari is a vocalist, researcher, composer, and academician specializing in Hindustani Classical Music. She earned her Ph.D. from Dayalbagh Educational Institute (DEI), Agra. She previously served as a Guest Faculty in the Department of Music at DEI. Dr. Darash is an accomplished composer with 50 original musical compositions to her credit. Her academic excellence and contributions to Indian music have been recognized through several prestigious honours, including the Sangeet Manishi Raghunath Talegaonkar Award & the International Women Achiever Award. Emeritus Visits
Padma Bhushan Prof. Arogyaswami Paulraj
Fellow- IEEE, Fellow- Institution of Engineers, Fellow-The World Academy of Sciences, Fellow-Marconi Society, Fellow-Institution of Electronics and Telecom Engineers, India. Prof. Paulraj is an Emeritus Professor, Department of Electrical Engineering at Stanford University and a Pioneer in MIMO Wireless. He has graduated 50 doctoral and post-doctoral scholars at Stanford.
Prof. Paulraj served in the Indian Navy from 1965 to 1991, during which period, he headed the APSOH sonar program, one of India’s most successful military R&D projects. He also founded three national level labs in Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, High Performance Computing and Military Electronics. After joining Stanford in 1991, Paulraj founded Iospan Wireless Inc. (1998) which pioneered MIMO-OFDMA used in 4G, co-founded Beceem Communications Inc. (2004) which became the leader in 4G / WIMAX chip sets and co-founded Rasa Networks (2014) that developed AI tools for WiFi management.

He is a member of eight National Academies including those of USA, China, India and Sweden.

Prof. L.M. Patnaik
Prof. L.M. Patnaik is currently an Honorary Professor Department of Electronic Systems Engineering (formerly CEDT) at Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore. During March 2008 - August 2011, he was the Vice Chancellor, Defence Institute of Advanced Technology, Deemed University, Pune. Prior to this he was a Professor with the Department of Computer Science and Automation at the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore. He obtained his Ph.D in 1978 in the area of Real-Time Systems, D.Sc. in 1989 in the areas of Computer Systems and Architectures, both from the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore
He is Fellow of the IEEE, The Academy of Sciences for the Developing World (TWAS), The Computer Society of India, Indian National Science Academy, Indian Academy of Sciences, National Academy of Sciences, and Indian National Academy of Engineering. He is a Distinguished Lecturer of the IEEE Region 10 and a distinguished Visitor of the IEEE Computer Society for the Asia-Pacific Region.
He has published over 700 papers in refereed International Journals and refereed International Conference Proceedings and authored 27 technical reports. He is a co-editor/co-author of 21 books and authored 12 chapters in other books in the areas of VLSI System Design and Parallel Computing, He has supervised over 30 Doctoral theses and over 160 Masters theses in the above areas.
As a recognition of his contributions in the areas of Electronics, Informatics, Telematics and Automation, he was awarded the Dr. Vikram Sarabhai Research Award in 1989,The VASVIK Award in the Field of Electronic Sciences and Technology, Vividhlaxi Audyogik Samshodhan Vikas Kendra,1996, The Fourth Sir C V Raman Memorial Lecture Award in 2000, The IEEE Computer Society Meritorious Service Award, 2002, Indian Science Congress Association Srinivasa Ramanujan Birth Centenary Award, 2007-2008 and Distinguished Alumnus Award, 2012, National Institute of Technology, Rourkela to name a few of the many awards to his name.

faculty-mallikharjuna_rao_k:p003.text:
Mallikharjuna Rao K
Brief Profile :
Dr. Mallikharjuna Rao K is currently serving as Assistant Professor (Grade-I) in the Department of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at the International Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Naya Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India.
Prior to this position, he worked as an Assistant Professor (Senior Grade-I) at VIT-AP University, Andhra Pradesh (2019–2021). He also served as an Associate Professor at Shri Vishnu Engineering College for Women, Bhimavaram (2018–2019). Earlier, he was associated with GITAM University, Visakhapatnam (2011–2018) and Gokaraju Rangaraju Institute of Engineering and Technology, Hyderabad (2007–2011) as an Assistant Professor.
Dr. Rao received his Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering (2018) and M.Tech. in Computer Science (2010) from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH). He earned his B.Tech. in Information Science and Technology from Acharya Nagarjuna University, Andhra Pradesh, in 2004.
He has successfully secured research funding, including a grant of ₹6 lakhs from the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, for organizing a National Workshop on Data Science Research at GITAM University, and ₹3.69 lakhs from NTPC Ltd. for research activities at IIIT Naya Raipur.
Dr. Rao has published over 60 research papers in reputed international journals and conferences. He holds one Indian granted patent and has two published Indian patents to his credit.
He served as an editorial board member and reviewer for several reputed SCI/WoS/Scopus-indexed journals, including IET Software, IEEE Sensors Journal, CMBBE, IJSAEM, JCS, JSR, IJECE, IJCS, BEEI, and IJSER. He has also chaired technical sessions at major international conferences, including IEEE WIECON-ECE 2022, ICCIDE 2022, and TRIBES 2021. Additionally, he has served as a Technical Program Committee (TPC) member and reviewer for various Springer and IEEE conferences, including WCAIC 2023, ICDSA 2023, CVR 2023, InC4 2023, ICCCT 2023, TENSYMP 2022, AIC 2022, and ICCIS 2022.
Dr. Rao is a Senior Member of IEEE, including IEEE Computational Intelligence Society (CIS) and IEEE Computer Society (CS), and a Life Member of the Computer Society of India (CSI).
His research interests include Artificial Intelligence, particularly Evolutionary Algorithms, Swarm Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Data Mining, Data Privacy, Imbalanced Data Learning, and their applications in healthcare and finance.

Mithilesh Kumar Chaube
Brief Profile :
Dr. Mithilesh Kumar Chaube is an Assistant Professor of Mathematics in Humanities & Social Science discipline. Prior to joining IIIT-NR, he was an Assistant Professor in RKGIT Ghaziabad, Galgotias University, Greater Noida and Echelon Institute of Technology, Faridabad. He has qualified CSIR-UGC NET and was a recipient of MHRD IIT-BHU scholarship assistance during his Ph.D. tenure.He has published several journal papers in journals of international repute.

Punya Prasanna Paltani
Brief Profile :
Dr. Punya P. Paltani is an Assistant Professor of Physics in the Science and Mathematics discipline. Prior to joining IIIT-NR, he was an Assistant Professor in Mody University, Rajasthan. He is a lifetime member of the Indian Physics Association, Optical Society of India, Senior member of Optical Society of America, and Senior IEEE Fellow. He was awarded Best Teacher Award by The Association of Engineers (India), CSIR Fellowship for doctoral research and TUBITAK Fellowship (by TURKISH Govt.) for Post-Doctoral research. He has published over 56 journal and conference papers; named 3 Indian patents, and authored a book on the topic ‘Optical Beam Propagation in Nonlinear Media and All-Optical Devices’.

faculty-ruhul_amin:p003.text:
Ruhul Amin
Brief Profile :
Dr. Ruhul Amin is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering Discipline. Prior to joining IIIT Naya Raipur, he was an assistant professor of NIT Jamshedpur. Dr. Amin received doctoral (Ph.D.) degree in Computer Science and Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology(ISM) Dhanbad, Jharkhand, India, in 2017 and received B.Tech and M.Tech both in Computer Science and Engineering from Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal, India in 2009 and 2013, respectively. He has authored many technical research papers published in leading international conferences and peer-reviewed international journals from the IEEE, Elsevier, Springer, John Wiley, etc. He is an Associate Editor of “Security and Privacy” and "Security and communication networks" published by John Wiley and Hindwai respectively. He is an active senior member of IEEE and a member of ACM.
In 2021, Stanford University has released a list that represents the top 2 per cent of the most-cited scientists in various disciplines. In recognition of exceptional research performance demonstrated by production of multiple highly cited papers, Dr. Amin made it to the list of Top 2% of the most cited scientists released by the US-based prestigious standford university.

Shailesh Khapre
Brief Profile :
Dr. Shailesh Khapre is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at DSPM IIIT-Naya Raipur, C. G. India. He received the B.Tech. Degree (Comp. Sci. & Engg.) from the NIT Rourkela, Orissa, in 2009, and the M.Tech. Degree (Comp. Sci. & Engg.) from Pondicherry University, Puducherry in 2011. He obtained a Ph.D. degree from the Pondicherry University, Puducherry, India in 2019-20 in the area of Information Retrieval. Earlier, he worked with the SRM-IST (Ghaziabad), and Amity University, Noida as an Assistant professor.
Dr. Shailesh is a recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship (RGNF_2012) for the year 2012-2016 by the UGC, Govt. of India and has published research work in various reputed journals with IEEE, Elsevier, Springer, etc. His current research interest is in Intelligent Information Retrieval, Robot Perceptions, Sensory Fusion, Computer Vision, Machine learning, Localization, Planning, Navigation.

Shrivishal Tripathi
Web Url: https://sites.google.com/site/tripathishrivishal/home
Brief Profile :
Shrivishal Tripathi is an Associate Professor at the International Institute of Information Technology, Naya Raipur, Chhattisgarh. He previously served as an Assistant Professor at BITS-Pilani, Hyderabad, and NIIT University, Neemrana. He earned his Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering from IIT Jodhpur in 2015, an M.E. from PEC University of Technology, Chandigarh, in 2011, and a B.Tech. from Dr. K.N. Modi Institute of Engineering and Technology, Ghaziabad, in 2009. His main research interest includes UWB / MIMO Antenna, Antenna for 5G/6G and IoT, AI in Electromagnetics, ML/DL in RF Circuit Design, Energy Harvesting, UAV, and Signal Modulation/Demodulation Techniques. He has successfully completed 06 sponsored/consultancy projects as PI/Co-PI sanctioned by DST, IGKV Raipur, CCOST, and Mahyco Pvt. Ltd. In addition, 03 more projects are currently in progress. He has published 80+ papers in reputed Journals and international/national conferences. He has organized many workshops and FDP. He serves on the Standing Review Committee for the Radio Altimeter System in DRDO Hyderabad, a Ministry of Defense, Govt. of India division and IIRS-ISRO, Department of Space (DOS) Govt. of India outreach program's coordinator. He contributed in the "National Rogue Drone Policy." under the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA).

Shubhangi Nema
Brief Profile :
Prior to joining IIIT-NR, I served as a Principal Project Scientist at IIT Delhi, where I worked on a research project funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), New Delhi. I received my Ph.D. in Systems and Control Engineering from IIT Bombay. I am also a recipient of the prestigious Prime Minister’s Research Fellowship (PMRF), awarded to outstanding research scholars pursuing doctoral research at Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs). I actively contribute to the research community as a reviewer for several IEEE and IFAC conferences and leading journals published by Springer and Wiley and invited for talks in many prestigious institutes of national importance.

faculty-srinivasa_k_g:p003.text:
Srinivasa K G
Brief Profile :
Dr. Srinivasa K G is a Professor of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence Programme at DSPM IIIT-Naya Raipur, C. G. India. Earlier he worked as a Professor at Information Management and Emerging Engineering Department of National Institute of Technical Teachers Training and Research, Chandigarh an autonomous Institute under Ministry of Education, Government of India. He also worked as an Associate Professor at CBP Government Engineering College, New Delhi (through UPSC) between 2016 – 19. He also served as Professor in the Department of CSE at M S Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bangalore between 2003 – 2016.
He received his Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from Bangalore University in 2007. He is the recipient of All India Council for Technical Education – Career Award for Young Teachers, Indian Society of Technical Education – ISGITS National Award for Best Research Work Done by Young Teachers, Institution of Engineers (India) – IEI Young Engineer Award in Computer Engineering, Rajarambapu Patil National Award for Promising Engineering Teacher Award from ISTE – 2012, IMS Singapore – Visiting Scientist Fellowship Award. He has published more than 150 research papers in International Conferences and Journals. He has visited many Universities abroad as a visiting researcher – He has visited University of Oklahoma, USA, Iowa State University, USA, Hong Kong University, Korean University, National University of Singapore, University of British Columbia, Canada are his few prominent visits. He has authored many books in the area of Learning Analytics, Network Data Analytics, Soft Computing, Social Network Analysis, High Performance Computing, R Programming etc. with prestigious international publishers like Springer, TMH, Oxford, Cengage, and IGI Global. He has edited research monographs in the area of Cyber Physical Systems, Fog Computing and Energy Aware Computing with CRC Press and IGI Global.
He has been awarded BOYSCAST Fellowship by DST, Govt. of India, for conducting post-doctoral research work at University of Melbourne, Australia. He is the principal Investigator for many funded projects from AICTE, UGC, DRDO, and DST. He has undertaken consultancy projects worth 60 lakhs towards conducting Professional Development Programmes under World Bank Project. He is the senior member of IEEE and ACM. His recent research areas include Innovative Teaching Practices in Engineering Education, pedagogy; outcomes based education, and teaching philosophy.

Brief Profile :
Dr. Srishti Bachwani is an Assistant Professor at the International Institute of Information Technology, Naya Raipur (IIIT-NR). She holds a Ph.D. in Marketing from the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow, an MBA in Marketing, and a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science Engineering. Her interdisciplinary academic background enables her to integrate perspectives from technology, management, and consumer behaviour in her teaching and research. Her research has been published in international peer-reviewed journals and presented at leading academic conferences. Dr. Bachwani is particularly interested in interdisciplinary research that connects technology and business, with a focus on understanding how emerging digital technologies shape markets, organizations, and consumer decision-making.

Brief Profile :
Dr. Vinay Kumar is an Assistant Professor at IIIT Naya Raipur in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering. He completed his doctorate at CSE, IIT (BHU) Varanasi. Prior to joining IIIT Naya Raipur, he served as an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at NIT Jamshedpur and BIT Mesra, Ranchi. Office of the Director
DIRECTOR
PROF. (DR.) OM PRAKASH VYAS DIRECTOR, IIIT NAYA RAIPUR
Prof. (Dr.) Om Prakash Vyas is a distinguished academician, researcher, and institutional leader
with over three decades of experience in technical education, research, and academic
administration. He holds an MJech. in Computer Science from IIT Kharagpur and pursued
doctoral research at Technical University of Kaiserslautern, Germany, under a DAAD Fellowship.
As the founding Head of Computer Science at Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University, he established
Chhattisgarh's first formal Computer Science programme in 1992. His early initiatives played a
pioneering role in extending Computer Science and IT education across a large network of
affiliated colleges in Chhattisgarh, helping lay the foundation for the State's subsequent expansion
of IT education.
Prof. Vyas has had a long and significant association with IlIT Allahabad, beginning as Assistant Professor during 2002-03, in the
formative years of the Institute. He returned to IlIT-A in 2009 as Professor of Information Technology and continued there until
2026, serving in several academic and leadership responsibilities, including as Dean (Research & Development), Dean (Technology
Development) and Member of BoG. During this period, he contributed to the Institute’'s academic development, including the
conceptualization and introduction of the BTech. programme in IT-Business Informatics in 2019, and coordinated NEP 2020-
inspired academic reforms for B.Tech. programs.
He has successfully led several national and international collaborative research projects and has been a sought-after Visiting
Professor at multiple global institutions. These include the National Institute of Informatics, Tokyo (Japan, 2010), the University of
Paderborn (Germany, 2013-2017), Inria Lille (France, 2015), the University of Messina (Italy, 2016), Norwegian Technical University
(Norway), and Bielefeld University (Germany, 2018-2023), where he taught and conducted research every summer for five
consecutive years.
As Vice Chancellor and Director of IlIT-Naya Raipur, Prof. Vyas has successfully implemented an NEP 2020-inspired BTech.
curriculum with a flexible Major-Minor structure, enabling students across engineering branches to pursue interdisciplinary Minors
including Business Informatics, Digital Mobility, Digital Humanities, Cyber Security, and Quantum Computing. His leadership
emphasizes research excellence, innovation, multidisciplinary education, and industry-academia and international collaboration.
His academic interests span Data Science, Process Intelligence, Business Informatics, Explainable Al, Cyber Security, and Agentic Al.
He is currently pursuing international research collaborations in Agentic Al through Indo-Italian initiatives and Cyber Security for
Critical Infrastructure through Indo-Norwegian projects.

Brief Profile :
Dr. Srinivasa K G is a Professor of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence Programme at DSPM IlIT-Naya Raipur, C. G. India. Earlier he
worked as a Professor at Information Management and Emerging Engineering Department of National Institute of Technical Teachers
Training and Research, Chandigarh an autonomous Institute under Ministry of Education, Government of India. He also worked as an
Associate Professor at CBP Government Engineering College, New Delhi (through UPSC) between 2016 - 19. He also served as Professor in
the Department of CSE at M S Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bangalore between 2003 - 2016.
He received his Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering from Bangalore University in 2007. He is the recipient of All India Council for
Technical Education - Career Award for Young Teachers, Indian Society of Technical Education - ISGITS National Award for Best Research
Work Done by Young Teachers, Institution of Engineers (India) - IEI Young Engineer Award in Computer Engineering, Rajarambapu Patil
National Award for Promising Engineering Teacher Award from ISTE - 2012, IMS Singapore - Visiting Scientist Fellowship Award. He has
published more than 150 research papers in International Conferences and Journals. He has visited many Universities abroad as a visiting
researcher - He has visited University of Oklahoma, USA, lowa State University, USA, Hong Kong University, Korean University, National
University of Singapore, University of British Columbia, Canada are his few prominent visits. He has authored many books in the area of
Learning Analytics, Network Data Analytics, Soft Computing, Social Network Analysis, High Performance Computing, R Programming etc.
with prestigious international publishers like Springer, TMH, Oxford, Cengage, and IGI Global. He has edited research monographs in the
area of Cyber Physical Systems, Fog Computing and Energy Aware Computing with CRC Press and IGI Global.
He has been awarded BOYSCAST Fellowship by DST, Govt. of India, for conducting post-doctoral research work at University of Melbourne,
Australia. He is the principal Investigator for many funded projects from AICTE, UGC, DRDO, and DST. He has undertaken consultancy
projects worth 60 lakhs towards conducting Professional Development Programmes under World Bank Project. He is the senior member of
IEEE and ACM. His recent research areas include Innovative Teaching Practices in Engineering Education, pedagogy; outcomes based
education, and teaching philosophy.

Vision and Mission of IIIT Naya Raipur
VISION & MISSION
VISION
To be a leading technology institute that produces high quality IT professionals and fosters technological innovation for social upliftment.
MISSION
To create an Institute of Excellence in IT Education and Research for imparting knowledge through education, advancing knowledge
through research, and providing service to the region, nation and mankind to contribute towards the creation of a better society.

About IIIT Naya Raipur (Part A)
Dr. SPM lIIT-Naya Raipur, established by the International Institute of Information Technology University Act, 2013, enacted by the
Government of Chhattisgarh, is a joint venture by the Chhattisgarh State Government and National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC), a
central Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) under the Ministry of Power, Government of India.The institute is committed to pursue excellence
in higher education, research and development in Information Technology (IT) and associated disciplines. It firmly believes in bestowing
knowledge dissemination and imparting entrepreneurial skills to the students to enable them to address real world problems. To
empower this vision, IIIT-NR fosters state-of-the-art research and product development laboratories to carry out inter-disciplinary research
and product development endeavours.The institute is mentored by a highly eminent board comprising of :-
Prof. Dhananjai Pandey, Hon. Distinguished Professor, BHU (for life) and Distinguished Professor, IIT Bhilai Chairman
Prof. U B Desai , The Founding Director of [IT Hyderabad Member
Mr. Sujit Baksi, President Corporate Affairs,Tech Mahindra Member
A. Pinto, Retired Lead Director of the Chairman's Supervisory Board of the Emirates Investment Bank, UAE Member
Principal Secretary, Technical Education Department Member
Principal Secretary, Electronics & Information Technology Department, Government of Chhattisgarh Member
Director, Directorate of Technical Education Chhattisgarh Member
Regional Executive Director (Western Region-Il) NTPC Limited Member
Chief General Manager, NTPC's Lara Super Thermal Power Project Member
Head Power Management Institute, NTPC Member
Vice Chancellor & Director, Dr. SPM IIIT-NR Member Secretary
Dr. SPM IIIT-NR's fifty-acres residential campus is located in the newly developed smart city of Atal Nagar, approximately 23 kms from the
city of Raipur. The vibrant lush green campus of IIIT-NR is enabled with Wi-Fi connectivity, CCTV surveillance, hi tech security measures and
excellent amenities for sports and other recreational activities. The modern architecture of the buildings and the serene environment of
the campus fosters an ambience for the students for creativity and innovation. The classrooms are equipped with state-of-the art
technologies for teaching and learning.

The Chancellor
Hon'ble Governor of Chhattisgarh, Shri Biswabhusan Harichandan, is the Chancellor of
Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee International Institute of Technology - Naya Raipur (IIIT-NR).
He assumed the office of the Governor on February 23, 2023. Before serving as the Governor
of Chhattisgarh, he was the Governor of the State of Andhra Pradesh.
Shri Harichandan is an ardent democrat in all respect who fights for human rights,
democracy, democratic values, and citizens’ rights, especially rights of down trodden people
and against corruption. He has an enriching political career. He was elected to the Odisha State
Legislative Assembly five times. He has served people in various capacities including Revenue
Minister, Law Minister, Industry Minister in the then Odisha Government. He also served as
Cabinet Minister in 1977 (during emergency), and as the Chairman of the Cabinet Sub-
Committee on Rehabilitation and Re-settlement of the displaced persons which was then the
best Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Policy of the Country.
Shri Harichandan is also a reputed columnist who has written several articles on
contemporary political issues, historical, social and cultural matters, which have been published
in all leading newspapers of Odisha and some English weeklies of Delhi. He is an inspiring
author and has significant literary contributions to his name, including his autobiography-
‘Battle Not Yet Over’, which is focussed on his struggle in political, administrative, social,
cultural and other fields during his long public life.

Annual Report 2022-23
03
Director’s Note
It’s indeed a privilege to present the Annual Report
2022-23 of this rapidly growing IIIT-Naya Raipur.
About 8 years ago, IIIT-NR embarked upon its journey
to realize the State Government’s vision to create a
premier technical institute of the country in Chhattisgarh.
I am proud to report that “Team IIIT-NR” has
successfully converted this dream into reality. With an
annual intake of only 80 students in two B. Tech.
programmes in 2015, today IIIT-NR offers three B. Tech.
programmes, four M. Tech. disciplines, multi-
disciplinary M. S. (by Research) and Ph. D. programmes,
with a total annual intake of 230 students. These
programmes cover a wide range of state-of-the-art
technology disciplines.
Our industry-oriented teaching-learning pedagogy helped achieve 100% placements in the first
four consecutive years, with an average package higher than parallel institutes. Some of our key
campus recruiters include Microsoft Research, American Express, Zeiss, Apra Labs, Big
Basket, Cognizant, Lumiq, Infosys, KPMG, Capgemini, PharmEasy, Ericsson, Deloitte etc.. In
addition, students interested in higher studies secured admissions in renowned academic
institutes both in India and abroad. These include IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, University of
Massachusetts Amherst (USA), University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (USA), Cornell
University (USA), and Carnegie Mellon University (USA).
Team IIIT-NR firmly believes that both education and research are equally important for a
premier Higher Education Institute (HEI). Hence, just like innovative academic programmes,
IIIT-NR took a unique approach to carve out its research landscape. It decided to make IIIT-NR
“A Living Research Lab for Agriculture, Forestry and Rural Development”, by focusing on
applications of ICET (Information, Communication and Electronics Technologies) for
agriculture, forestry and rural development. Being situated in Chhattisgarh, a state rich in
agriculture and forestry, and dominated by rural population, we chose to focus on these areas
so that we can effectively contribute to the inclusive development of the state. I am proud to
report that IIIT-NR is currently pursuing several funded research projects in these areas which
have resulted in the publication of 242 journal papers, 18 book chapters, 4 books, and 7 patents
in the year 2022-23. Our faculty members also conducted several Faculty Development
Programs (funded by AICTE) in futuristic technology domains like Robotics, Artificial
Intelligence, Data Science, etc.
֍ IIIT-Naya Raipur | Annual Report | 2022-23 ֍ 3
Annual Report 2022-23
With its firm belief in advancing society through multidisciplinary collaborative research, IIIT-
NR has signed MoUs with several premier academic and research institutes. These include All
India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Raipur, DRDO, C-DAC, Microsoft Research Lab,
Samsung R&D, Louisiana State University (USA), Wright State University (USA), Indira
Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV), SECQAI Ltd. (UK) etc. For increased interactions
with researchers across the globe, IIIT-NR started its own international conference named
TRIBES (Technology, Research, and Innovation for BEtterment of Society). To encourage its
members to actively participate in professional societies globally, IIIT-NR has established IEEE
Student Branch and IEEE Women in Engineering Affinity Group. In December 2022, it also
hosted the IEEE International Women in Engineering Conference. With these initiatives, the
institute and the State of Chhattisgarh are gaining increased popularity nationally and
internationally as a research hub.
Through its entrepreneurship initiatives, IIIT-NR also motivates and nurtures its students to
become job creators as an entrepreneur. The institute received the ‘Start Me Up Award’ by
Wadhwani Foundation for its entrepreneurship initiatives and active participation in global
entrepreneurship competitions. Recognizing the new wave where startups will be the dominant
job creators of the future, the institute is also setting up an incubation facility in the campus.
The institute got 3.5-Star rating by the Institution Innovation Council (IIC), Ministry of
Education (MoE) and ‘Peformers Band’ in Atal Rankings of Institutions on Innovation
Achievements (ARIIA).
To develop the sense of social responsibility in its members, IIIT-NR has established ISR
(Institute Social Responsibility) Cell and NSS (National Social Service) unit in its campus.
Through these units, IIIT-NR members help less privileged sections of our society in various
ways. For example, the institute has adopted two nearby villages (Rakhi and Uparwara) where
it conducts special classes for village school children; conducts cleanliness and awareness
programmes for the villagers; undertakes projects for tribal and rural development; conducts
invited talks for members of other technical institutes to share the best practices of IIIT-NR;
conducts summer camps for school children; conducts an annual event called ‘SCIƞTFIC’
(Science and Technology over Fiction) to motivate school children towards career in Science
and Technology etc.
In addition to our students excelling globally in various ways as mentioned above, several
faculty members received international recognitions like selection/ nomination in executive
positions in professional societies, elevation to IEEE Senior Member Grade, Gold Faculty
Award by Wadhwani Foundation, etc. One of our faculty, Dr. Ruhul Amin, got listed for two
consecutive years, among the top 2% most-cited scientists globally in the list released by
Stanford University, USA.
To sum up, 2022-23 has been a year of success and accelerated growth of IIIT-NR. I
acknowledge that the success and the brand that IIIT-NR has earned in this short span would
not have been possible without the wholehearted support of Govt. of Chhattisgarh and NTPC
and our visionary Board members for their guidance and support in all matters. I extend my
sincere thanks to all stakeholders including the brilliant efforts of talented students, academic
accomplishments of our faculty members and committed staff.
Dr. Pradeep Kumar Sinha
Vice Chancellor and Director
Dr. SPM IIIT-Naya Raipur

Annual Report 2022-23

About the Institute
Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee International Institute of Information Technology – Naya Raipur
(IIIT-NR) is a joint venture by Govt. of Chhattisgarh and National Thermal Power Corporation
(NTPC). The institute is established by the International Institute of Information Technology
University Act, 2013 of the Govt. of Chhattisgarh “to promote and facilitate studies, research,
incubation and extension work in Information Technology and in its application domain and
related areas of knowledge and to achieve excellence in these fields and matters connected
therewith or incidental thereto.”
As enshrined in the Act, IIIT-Naya Raipur is committed to pursue excellence in higher
education, research and development in Information Technology (IT) and associated
disciplines. It firmly believes in bestowing knowledge dissemination and imparting
entrepreneurial skills to the students to enable them to address real world problems. To empower
this vision, IIIT-NR fosters state-of-the-art research and product development laboratories to
carry out inter-disciplinary research and product development endeavours. The institute is
mentored by a highly eminent board comprising of industry leaders, erudite academicians and
administrators.

IIIT-NR Logo
Description of Logo
The logo of Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee IIIT-Naya Raipur
is designed to capture the Institute’s vision towards its social
responsibility along with its name and location. The logo
indicates that our institute is located in the State of
Chhattisgarh and provides an environment to foster
knowledge enrichment and development of humane qualities
to enable individuals to emerge as enlightened citizens, who
can lead a peaceful and contended life. The various
components of the logo signify the following:
Buddha: “Buddha” signifies enlightenment (an ideal state of
intellectual and ethical perfection) through gain of knowledge,
discipline, dedication and concentration. This object in the logo
indicates that DSPM-IIIT Naya Raipur nurtures such qualities in its
students and other members.
Circle Around Buddha: This artistically designed circle has both the
letters ‘C’ and ‘G’ embedded, signifying Chhattisgarh. This object in
the logo indicates that DSPM-IIIT Naya Raipur is located in and is
supported by the State of Chhattisgarh.
Sanskrit Shloka: Taken from Bhagavad Gita
(4:39), it means that ultimate wisdom and
peace in life can be achieved only by
acquiring knowledge. This object in the logo indicates that DSPM-IIIT Naya Raipur strives hard
to impart as much knowledge as possible to its students and other members to help them lead a
peaceful and contended life.
Institute Name in Long and Short
Forms: The logo also contains the institute’s
name in both long and short forms.

Annual Report 2022-23
IIIT-NR Vision and Mission
Vision
To be a leading technology institute that produces high quality IT professionals and fosters
technological innovation for social upliftment.
Mission
To create an Institute of Excellence in IT Education and Research for imparting knowledge
through education, advancing knowledge through research, and providing service to the region,
nation and mankind to contribute towards the creation of a better society.
Vision 2.0
The first five-year focus of the institute was to properly establish its education and culture
components. The next five year vision (IIIT-NR 2.0) focuses on strengthening the research
component of the institute with a motto to transform the institute into “A Living Research Lab
for Agriculture, Forestry and Rural Development” by focusing on the application of ICET
(Information, Communication and Electronics Technologies) for agriculture, forestry, and rural
development.

Labs @ IIIT-NR
To provide students with hands-on experience for strong practical and technical skills with focus
on real world problems and also to facilitate quality teaching, learning, and research, the IIIT-
NR has setup various state-of-the-art labs. These are as follows:-
 The 3D Printing & Fabrication Lab
The 3D Printing and Fabrication Lab is a state-of-the-art digital manufacturing space. It allows
students to quickly fabricate parts from computer generated designs to rapidly iterate prototype
designs.
 VLSI Embedded System Lab
VLSI Embedded System Lab is well equipped with industry standard VLSI tools and hardware
resources like Raspberry PI board, Universal FPGA/CPLD Card, XILINX FPGA -ADD ON
Card, XILINX FPGA ZYNQ, etc. The primary objective of the lab is to provide hands-on
experience to students in the field of analog, digital and mixed-signal circuit design so that they
can conduct world class research, produce competitive results, create solutions tailored to
society's needs, and to disseminate knowledge for public use.
 BigData Computing Lab
BigData Computing Lab enables training and research in all aspects of large and distributed
information systems (e.g. system development, testing, maintenance, data integration,
networking, and application development). It prepares students for emerging cutting-edge
technologies in the fast-growing IT industry such as BigData Computing, Healthcare
Informatics, Data Integration and Data Analytics.
 Internet of Things & Sensors Lab
IoT Lab is at the forefront of developing both hardware, including novel sensors,
communication platform and analytics for Internet of Things (IoT) and smart environments. The
IoT lab provides necessary software and equipment to develop and characterize novel smart
sensors for IoT applications. Along with these, the lab is equipped with various kits like Smart
Healthcare, Smart Agriculture, Smart Village/ City.
 Network Lab
Fully equipped with Dell PCs and Netsim, Ns2 Simulators, the Network lab enables students to
conduct research in the area of wired and wireless networks. The lab also emphasizes
experimental research in the area of communication networking.
 Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning (AIDL) Lab
The AIDL Lab enables the students to carry out experiments and research on a variety of topics
within Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning with focus on using real world problems to
discover computationally hard problems of modelling uncertainty, learning predictive models
and enabling decision making.
֍ IIIT-Naya Raipur | Annual Report | 2022-23 ֍ 25

general-annual_report_2022_2023:p024.text:
Annual Report 2022-23
 Communication Lab
The Communication Lab provides necessary hardware and software resources to the
undergraduate and research students of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) for
enhancing their skills in the communication field. Theory in the classroom is translated directly
into practice with the help of the Ettus USRP software defined radio platform and
Matlab/National Instruments LabVIEW. The emphasis is on physical layer concepts rather than
implementation considerations.
 Electronic Circuit Lab
The primary objective of this Lab is to provide engineering skills by way of breadboard circuit
design with electronic devices and components and to analyse various electronic circuits and
digital circuits such as multi-vibrators, Flip-Flop circuits, applications of operational amplifiers,
RC coupled amplifiers, oscillators, etc. so that students are able to understand the practical
aspects of basic electronics theory. It also enables the students to simulate and test the Analog,
Digital and mixed electronics circuits using Verilog, Matlab and OrCAD software.
 Computer Programming Lab
Computer Programming Lab is a hands-on project and assignment-based learning space where
students can gain strong practical and technical skills in various programming languages,
including C, Python, Java, UNIX/Linux: shell, tools, utilities and programming environments,
user interfaces, and software engineering principles.
 Antenna & Microwave Circuit Design Lab
This Lab supports intermediate and advanced courses in Electromagnetics and Microwave
Engineering. The microwave laboratories provide the necessary support for training the students
in the area of RF and Microwave Engineering. It offers analysis and simulation of various
components and devices to understand the basics of RF and microwave engineering, to boost
the quality of engineering education, deepen understanding, and provide the necessary practical
skills to young minds.
 Data Science Lab
Data Science Lab is configured to not only facilitate students to practice basic programming in
C, C++ and JAVA; but also to learn advanced technologies of computer science such as
Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Data Mining. The Lab facilitates
database designing and management through dedicated tools such as Oracle and MySQL, and
related computing paradigm and frameworks.
 Language Lab
The blended methodology used at the Language Laboratory caters to the language needs of
students by providing them suitable environment for self-paced effective language learning. The
primary objective of the lab is to enhance language learning skills of the students based on their
individual requirements. The lab is well-equipped with Digital Language Learning Software
platform that aims to facilitate efficient teacher-student interaction to correct phonetic accents
and dialects.

Collaborations & Conferences
Collaborations and MOUs
As the purpose of any collaboration or MoU with other higher educational institutions and
industry is to develop co-operation and promote mutual understanding and excellence in
practice-based education, research and knowledge exchange between the parties so that the
research and knowledge developed is used for further research and its applications at regional,
national and global level, IIIT-NR is proactively involved in increasing collaboration with other
higher educational institutions and industry.
With its firm belief in advancing society through multidisciplinary collaborative research, IIIT-
NR has signed MoUs with several premier academic and research institutes. These include All
India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)
Raipur, DRDO, C-DAC, Microsoft
Research Lab, Samsung R&D, Louisiana
State University (USA), Wright State
University (USA), Indira Gandhi Krishi
Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV), SECQAI Ltd.
(UK) etc.
In the year 2022-23, IIIT-NR signed MoU
with five reputed organisations. The brief
details of these recent MoUs are as follows:-
 IIIT-NR and Samsung (SRI-B)
Samsung Research Institute Bangalore (SRI-B), Samsung’s largest R&D facility outside
Korea, is engaged in the development of software and applications for cellular phones, tablets,
laptops, computers and other information technology and telecom products. It collaborates with
students and faculty at partner institutes, giving them research as well as development
projects to be executed over four to six months. With this MOU, students of IIIT-NR will get
to work on projects in cutting edge technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (including
Vision Tech), Machine Learning, Internet of Things and Connected Devices and 5G
networks, to solve real-time problems of industry. Each project is taken up by a team of three
students and one professor, with a mentor from SRI-B, who guides and trains them, and
conducts regular reviews.

Annual Report 2022-23
 IIIT-NR and SECQAI, London
SECQAI is a London based company inventing new hardware and software focused on solving
the energy problem of Models, Simulations and Artificial Intelligence. As per the MOU,
Research Internships of total Rs. 14,00,000/- were provided to the students of IIIT-NR to carry
out few select research projects of SECQAI.
 IIIT-NR and GeeksforGeeks
GeeksforGeeks is India's biggest coding and tech-community. It conducted one of the largest
and the most rewarding hackathon events in the country, sponsored by Google Cloud India, and
this MoU was for mutual cooperation for the conduct of the Hackathon. The hackathon provided
students with all necessary resources, such as mentors, access to Google’s technical resources,
and prize money. Top-performers were rewarded with exciting prizes and certificates.
Hackathons are a great way for students to learn as well as demonstrate their skill-sets while
working with industry-leading companies like Google.
 IIIT-NR and UiPath
An academic collaboration has been done between IIIT-Naya Raipur and UiPath, a global
software company that makes robotic process automation software for collaboration on growing
the Robotic Process Automation (RPA) knowledge ecosystem.
 IIIT-NR and IIIT-B COMET Foundation
IIIT-Naya Raipur and IIIT-Bangalore COMET Foundation entered into an MoU on June 8, 2022
in the field of Advanced Communication Systems (“Project”) as per the Tripartite Agreement
dated March 30, 2021 between IIIT-Bangalore and COMET with the Mission Director, Mission
Office NM-ICPS, Ministry of Science & Technology, Department of Science & Technology,
Government of India to create a strong foundation and a seamless ecosystem for Cyber Physical
Systems technologies. Duration of the Project is 4 years with an outlay of Rs. 1,73,56,000/-.
 IIIT-NR, IIT Kharagpur and IIT Kanpur collaboration for Tribe Connect Project
IIIT-NR team of researchers in collaboration with IIT Kanpur and IIT Kharagpur are working
on ‘Tribe Connect Project’ funded by the Ministry of
Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Govt.
of India. In this project, the team is working on three
areas, Health, Agriculture and Education. For
Healthcare, ‘Tribe Aid’ platform has been developed,
which helps in detecting Anemia and Lung Disease. For
Agriculture ‘Hamar Kisan’ platform has been developed,
which helps in detecting diseases in crops. For
Education, ‘Tribe Guru’ platform has been developed,
with the help of which school administration and parents
can monitor the health, location and concentration of the
students. The whole process has been patented.

and Beyond’, at the International Conference on Human Machine Interaction (ICISHMC 2022),
on July 09, 2022.

Conference on Blockchain and Distributed
Systems Security (ICBDS) 2022’, from
September 16-18, 2022, at Pune. The conference

engineers, and practitioners to contribute to

Beyond’, organized by the Department of Information Technology and Department of Computer
Science & Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Raipur, on September 19, 2022.

Annual Report 2022-23
Elevation to ‘IEEE Senior Member’ Grade
The following faculty members of IIIT-NR have been elevated to ‘IEEE Senior Member’ grade
during this year, an honour bestowed by IEEE for significant contributions to the profession:-
 Dr. Punya Prasanna Paltani, Assistant Professor (Physics)
 Dr. Ramakrishna Bandi, Assistant Professor (Mathematics)
 Dr. Shrivishal Tripathi, Assistant Professor (ECE)
 Dr. Srinivas Naik, Assistant Professor (CSE)
IIIT-NR IEEE WIE Affinity Group
IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE) Affinity Group under IIIT-NR student branch was
approved by IEEE. The IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE) is a global network of IEEE
members and volunteers dedicated to promoting women engineers and scientists, and inspiring
girls around the world to follow their academic interests in a career in engineering and science.
IEEE is the world’s largest technical professional organization dedicated to advancing
technology for the benefit of humanity.
Prof. Rajesh Ingle Received Cloud Security Alliance
Certificates
Prof. Rajesh Ingle (Dean Academics) received two
certificates from Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) for his
contributions to two modules namely “Introduction to
Zero Trust Architecture” and “Key Features and
Technologies of Software Defined Perimeter”.
Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) is the world’s leading
organization dedicated to defining and raising awareness
of best practices to help ensure a secure cloud computing
environment. CSA team as a part of Cloud Security
Alliance's training program, thanked Prof. Rajesh Ingle for
his incredible contributions to the Zero Trust Training.
This courseware was made possible by his commitment to
vendor-neutrality, student understanding, and precision.
Google Developer Student Club
IIIT-NR initiated Google Developer Student
Club, supported by Google, at its campus. It
will play an instrumental role in building a
strong community in the campus through which
IIIT-NR students can become industry ready by
learning the latest trends in technology and
build projects that solve real world challenges.

Dr. Kuldip Received SERB International Research Experience Fellowship
Dr. Kuldip Singh Patel, Assistant Professor (Mathematics),
was awarded the ‘SERB International Research Experience
(SIRE) Fellowship’ by the Department of Science &
Technology (DST), Government of India. Under this
fellowship, Dr. Kuldip visited University of Mauritius to
work with scientists there on financial market problems,
specifically ‘High-Order Compact Schemes for Pricing
Interest Rate Derivatives’.
The SIRE fellowship helped IIIT-NR to increase its visibility
in India and abroad, and to open various research/intern/post-
doctoral opportunities to the B. Tech./ M. Tech. students and
research scholars of IIIT-NR.
IIIT-NR Received Appreciation Certificate from the Hon’ble Governor of Chhattisgarh
IIIT-NR received ‘Certificate of
Appreciation’ issued by Indian Red Cross
Society, CG State Branch, at the hands of
then Hon'ble Governor of Chhattisgarh, Ms.
Anusuiya Uikey, for the Voluntary Blood
Donation camps organised by the institute
during the last few years. The certificate was
awarded on the occasion of ‘World Blood
Donor Day’ on June 14, 2022. Dr. Pradeep
K. Sinha, Director, IIIT-NR, received the
certificate on behalf of the institute.
Winner of Tally CodeBrewers
Kushal Jain, student of IIIT-NR, won ‘Tally
CodeBrewers 2nd Edition’ in the ‘Wizard of System
Programming’ track, amongst over 2000+ entries from
across India. Kushal outshined in the high density online
quiz and coding followed by product development
challenge where he had to come up with a working
solution for one of the challenges using a technology of
his choice in 48 hours. Tally Code Brewers, by Tally
Solutions, was started in the year 2021 to inculcate and
promote the passion for innovation, logical thinking and
problem solving in the next generation of engineers. The
winners will get an opportunity to intern with Tally
Solutions and direct entry for campus placements.

Annual Report 2022-23
IIIT-NR Recognized for Swachhata Activities
Mahatma Gandhi National Council of Rural Education (MGNCRE), Ministry of Education,
Government of India appreciated the initiatives of IIIT-NR for maintaining one of the cleanest
and greenest campuses in the region. The Ministry has acknowledged that the Swachhata related
activities of the institute have been highly progressive and motivating.
Development of Software to Filter Toxic Comments on
Social Media
In order to keep the user safe on social media and to
maintain positivity on social media, a group of three
students namely Sayantan Roy, Rishi Shounak, and Vivek
Kumar, under the guidance of Dr. Vivek Tiwari, worked
on the development of a ‘Software that Filters Toxic
Comments on Social Media’. This software works on all
social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram,
Twitter, and YouTube.
The software works on a machine learning model. It has
its own data based on which it decides whether the
comment is negative or positive and if anyone posts a
negative comment, the filter automatically deletes it. The
software also allows the user to decide first whether he/she
wants to see the comment or wants to delete it
immediately.
Winners at NIT Raipur Entrepreneurship Summit
UniPlug, an entrepreneurial venture by IIIT-NR final year students
Yashasva Raj Sherke, Ojas Ankit and Priyansh Pandey, was
adjudged winner in the ‘Ignition - the B Plan Competition’
conducted under the aegis of the annual ‘Entrepreneurship
Summit’ of NIT Raipur held from December 02-04, 2022. In this
competition, the various startups shortlisted teams had to pitch
their ideas to the esteemed judges. The team won amongst 100+
startups after a stirring competition of three rounds.
A Few More Achievements
 IIIT-NR students Vinayak Srivastava, Aman Singh, Dhaval Kumar and Anisha Agrawal
won the National Level Hackathon hosted by the Centre for Networked Intelligence (CNI)
at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore. The hackathon had two tracks: Data
Science Challenge and an AI Challenge. The Data Science task involved a bus fleet
dataset obtained from BMTC (Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation). IIIT-NR
Team came 3rd in this track. The AI challenge consisted of building a bot that competes
with another bot to conquer more cells (area) in a grid. The IIIT-NR team of students
came 2nd in this track.

Annual Report 2022-23
 Team ‘Grotesque’ of IIIT-NR students presented
the idea on ‘Development of Online Projects
Progress Monitoring System for Funded Higher
Educational Institutions under Various Schemes
and the Funding Agencies’. The problem
statement was - To enhance the quality of financial
assistance being provided by several funding
agencies under respective notified schemes. The
agencies were categorized into Government,
Government-aided and Private.
 IIIT-NR team ‘Code Titans’, consisting of Vandit Tyagi and Devajit Patar won the
‘Interrupt, Innovate, Iterate (III)’ Hackathon, organized by ‘Gravity’, the technical
society of IIIT Allahabad. This 36 hours long hackathon was scheduled from Jan 20-23,
The aim of the event was to encourage the participants to dream big, enabling them
to learn and build a project from scratch, be it blockchain, AI/ML, or future mobility.
 IIIT-NR team ‘The Tag Ends’ emerged winners at the ‘Ethos Hackathon’ organized by
IIT Guwahat from December 17, 2022 to January 09, 2023. The hackathon focused on
real-world problem statements proposed by Saptang Labs and the Assam Police. IIIT-NR
team consisting of Devajit Patar, Vandit Tyagi, Ganesh Prajapati and Gautam Sarawagi
were adjudged winners in the Assam Police problem statement named ‘Smart Naka using
Deep Learning and AI’. The project aimed at improving traffic management, safety,
security and tracking criminals at Naka points (check-posts).
 Shri Dharmendra Pradhan, Cabinet Minister, Education and
Skill Development, Government of India discussed India's
Cyber Security matters with one of our alumni, Siddhant Dash.
Siddhant Dash was a Batch 2015-2019 student of IIIT-NR, who
did his Masters from Cornell University, USA after his B.
Tech. from IIIT-NR.
 IIIT-NR team ‘ChatGDP’, consisting of Aman Sahu, Sanskar
Singh, Rigved Desai, Shivaibhav Dewangan, Shivam
Kushwaha and Ravil Patel, won the first prize under the
problem statement category ‘Driver Monitoring’, at the
National Level Hackathon ‘CodeUtsava 6.0’ organized by NIT Raipur. The 28-hour long
hackathon focused on real-world problem statements. ChatGDP team of IIIT-NR had to
detect driver drowsiness using an externally integrated web camera and implement the
software in an Android application. The team created an app named ‘DriveSharp’.
 IIIT-NR team of B. Tech. students ‘Tokyo’ secured 3rd position at the National Level
Hackathon ‘Academic Grand Challenge on Climate Change’, organized by T-AIM in
association with Capgemini. The team consisted of Harsh Pandey, Subhanshu
Arya, Vishal Nitnaware and Aryaman and was mentored by Dr. Vivek Tiwari, Assistan
Professor (CSE). The hackathon aimed at finding solutions to tackle some of the most
pressing issues facing our planet today. The team worked for over two months, clearing
four successive stages and competing against 7,500+ teams to develop a holistic solution
that addressed climate change's challenges.

DARPAN - A Unique Career Guidance Initiative of IIIT-NR
Annual Career Guidance and Self-introspection Workshop “DARPAN” was conducted on May
21, May 28, and June 4, 2022, for all the first year B.Tech. students who joined in the year 2021.
The workshop provides a unique opportunity to the first year students to identify their strengths
and interests and pursue opportunities as per their potential. During the workshop, the students
develop a firm understanding of their long-term and short-
term goals with the help of SWOT analysis, i.e. they
identify and list down their strengths, weaknesses, threats
and opportunities. Each student is guided to self-
introspect and prepare and deliver a presentation before
the participating members.
DARPAN is a unique initiative of IIIT-NR, which enables
its students to plan their professional career right in their
first year and then work towards their plans for the next
three years. The workshop also helps the students in
sharpening their presentation, public speaking and soft
skills.
This noble initiative to prepare students to identify and
pursue their passion for excellence in their profession is
envisaged by the institute’s Centre for Professional
Development and is personally mentored by Dr. Pradeep
K. Sinha, Director, IIIT-NR.

ensuring that they are watered regularly. They pledged to
work for the betterment of the environment and help in the
conservation of flora in all possible ways.

Annual Report 2022-23
HackManthan
Chhattisgarh Police Department, in
collaboration with IIIT-Naya Raipur,
organized ‘HackManthan’, the first-ever
Cybersecurity Hackathon of
Chhattisgarh. The objective was to get
the best young minds in the IT field
working on real-life problems
threatening Cybersecurity and to resolve
to make the Internet a safer place.
Shri Ashok Juneja, Director General of
Police (DGP), Chhattisgarh, was the
Chief Guest and Dr. Pradeep Sinha,
Director IIIT-NR, was the Guest of
Honour for the inauguration ceremony,
which was held on June 15, 2022, at
Police Headquarters, Naya Raipur.
Around 460 teams registered for the
hackathon and prizes from a pool of Rs.
1,40,000/- were awarded to the winners.
The winning project was team ‘Third
Eye’ from Netaji Subhas University of
Technology, Delhi, which presented a solution based on Live Crime Tracking from CCTV
Surveillance. The second runner-up, team ‘Vaak Bhavna’ from IIIT-NR, won Rs. 20,000/- with
their solution for Call Analysis to Emergency Services.
International Yoga Day
IIIT-NR celebrated ‘International Yoga
Day’ on June 21, 2022. Mr. Hitesh Kumar
a yoga instructor from Raipur, took the
session, which was attended by the
Director, Dr. Pradeep Kumar Sinha,
faculty, staff, their family members, and a
large number of students of the institute.
The session was filled with meditation
and relaxation practices. The participants
were told about the primary poses and
their essence, do’s and don’ts, the benefits
of yoga, etc. The participants also pledged
to make yoga a part of their life. Emphasizing on good health, Dr. Sinha, Director IIIT-NR,
motivated the students and faculty members to practice yoga in their daily life and congratulated
them for observing the International Yoga Day by practicing various exercises.

A Professional Development Programme cum Hands-on Workshop on ‘Teaching, Learning,
Assessment and Curriculum Development-An Accreditation Perspective’ was conducted in the
campus on July 18, 2022. Director IIIT-NR and all the faculty members attended the workshop.
Standard Operating Procedures for applying to NAAC, NIRF and ABET were discussed in
detail. Revision of curriculum in compliance with accreditation agencies and finalization of
Programme Educational Objectives (PEOs), Program Outcomes (POs) and Programme Specific
Outcomes (PSOs) of all the B. Tech. and M. Tech. programmes offered by CSE, ECE and DSAI
were also discussed during the workshop.

collaborative and productive, celebrating 75th Year of Independence of India or ‘Azadi Ka Amrit
Mahotsav’, the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell and AICTE organized 15
IIC regional meets in different cities across the country. The programme provided a platform
for participating IIC institutions to showcase institutions' innovation and entrepreneurship
ecosystem preparedness, models/best practices, contributions, recent achievements and impacts
made in the last two academic years 2020-21, 2021-22. Dr. P. P. Paltani, Dr. Amit Agrawal, Dr.
Kuldip Singh Patel, and Dr. Vivek Tiwari of IIIT-NR attended the program at Nagpur on July
29, 2022.

Director IIIT-NR presented the status of academic and other activities of the institute as well as
the work done by the faculty, staff and students of the institute.

IIIT-NR launched the IEEE WIE (Women in
Engineering) Affinity Group on August 23,
2022, which is an international women
empowerment initiative, focused on
enlightening the society about the importance
of women’s role in social development, with
special emphasis on their role in Science and
Engineering. With the approval of IEEE, the
members of IEEE IIIT-NR Student Branch
formed this affinity group at IIIT-NR, to work
towards empowering the girls and women of
Chhattisgarh through their connections and
collaboration with the IEEE network
worldwide. Prof. Celia Shahnaz, the global
IEEE WIE Committee Chair for the year 2023-
24, was the Chief Guest and Ms. Sudeshna Chaudhary, Offering Owner, Partner Ecosystems
and Alliances, TATA Consultancy Services, was the Guest of Honour of the launch event
organized at IIIT-NR. The event was attended by the students, faculty and staff members of the
institute.

Shri Gurdeep Singh, Chairman & Managing Director, NTPC Ltd., visited the institute on August
26, 2022. He also interacted with the faculty, staff members and students of IIIT-NR. In his
address to them, he congratulated the IIIT-NR members for their efforts in bringing up the
institute at par with other premier technical institutes, in a short span of time. He motivated the
students and asked them to aim higher and to give back to the Institute and the State.

Visit by Rakuten Representative
Mr. Ashish Nanjiani, Vice President of
Engineering, Rakuten-India, visited IIIT-NR on

and other stakeholders of IIIT-NR for potential
collaboration, research, and campus relationship-

NR’s initiatives to strengthen industry-academia
ties and generate skilled human capital in
Chhattisgarh.
Run for Unity
National Service Scheme (NSS) unit of IIIT-NR in collaboration with SAC IIIT-NR organized
‘Run for Unity’, in the campus on October 31, 2022. Run for Unity is an initiative of the
Government of India to mark the birth anniversary
of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, known for his
supreme patriotism, iron will, and courage of
conviction. Faculty, staff members and students of
the institute enthusiastically participated in the
event and took the oath to protect the integrity of
India. After the pledge, the unity march was
organised. The enthusiastic students and faculty
chanted the slogans of unity which filled the
atmosphere with patriotism and brotherhood.
Orientation Programme for B.Tech. 2022 Batch
The four-day Orientation Program for the newly
admitted first year B. Tech. students of IIIT-Naya
Raipur was conducted from November 14-17, 2022.
The program was designed to cover detailed insight
into IIIT-NR’s culture, academics, administration,
and personality development activities conducted in
the institute. All newly admitted students, their
parents, faculty and staff members of the institute
attended the programme.
The Chief Guest of the program was Smt. R.
Shangeetha, Secretary Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh, and Dr.
Harold D'Costa, CEO of Intelligent Quotient Security, was the Guest of Honour for the event.
In her address to the students, Smt. R. Sangeetha, spoke about the importance of education in
one’s life. She also motivated the students by narrating her own life examples of being born in
a remote village of Tamil Nadu, to becoming the first woman Collector of her district.
Dr. Harold D'Costa, talked about the seven letters of ethics and motivated the students to work
hard to achieve their dreams. In his address, Dr. Pradeep Sinha motivated the students to set up

work harder and fulfil all their dreams. The inaugural session was followed by various sessions
on culture and values of the institute, hostel rules, IT infrastructure and their usage guidelines

IEEE Student Branch of IIIT-NR organized a seminar, ‘Technical
Evening on Data Science’ to enlighten the students with the

National Service Scheme (NSS) unit of IIIT-NR and
Student Activity Centre (SAC) of IIIT-NR, in coordination

doctors, under Dr. Sankalp Sharma, Additional Professor of
the Department of Transfusion Medicine and Blood Bank,
AIIMS Raipur, monitored the camp.

Dr. Pradeep K. Sinha, Director,

of Chhattisgarh on November 11,

Administration. The programme
was organized for Training Officers of Employment Department of Government of
Chhattisgarh. He was invited to speak about the various unique initiatives undertaken by IIIT-
NR in training the students to become successful professionals.
Expert Talks
 An expert talk on ‘Development of Compressed CNN
Models for Plant Disease Identification’ was delivered
on October 19, 2022 by Prof. K. K. Biswas, retired
Professor, IIT-Delhi. The talk was related to the work
done in the area of Automatic Plant Disease
Identification from leaf images, such as tomato, grapes,
and cucumber. A lot of literature is available on
applications of deep learning to solve this issue.
However, the sizes of the CNN (Convolution Neural
Networks) is so huge that it requires specialized
professional equipment. His work relates to reducing the
size of these networks, so that they can be easily deployed
on small devices like Raspberry Pi or mobile
phones. Using heuristic algorithms like differential
evolution and Particle Swarm Optimization, the huge CNN models have been compressed
to more than 80% of their size, while maintaining the accuracy of disease identification.

Annual Report 2022-23
Orientation Session of the Institutions' Innovation Council (IIC 5.0)
Entrepreneurship Cell (E-Cell) of IIIT-NR organized an Orientation Session of the ‘Institutions'
Innovation Council (IIC 5.0)’ for the Academic Year 2022-23 on January 11, 2023. Mr. Dipan
Kumar Sahu, Assistant Innovation Director at the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell &
AICTE, Government of India, delivered a
welcome note and discussed the features of the 5th
edition of IIC. He highlighted the achievements
and new features of IIC, including a reduction in
curriculum to generate space for critical thinking
and entrepreneurship. He also discussed the reach
of IIC coordinators across all states and union
territories in India, the main mission and objective
of establishing IIC cells under Ministry of
Education (MoE) guidelines in higher education institutions, and ways to increase performance
and award points. Additionally, he discussed the benefits of signing MoUs with external
agencies, submitting good quality videos, training Innovation Ambassadors, and using the
YUKTI platform for organizing innovation challenges and competitions. He also explained the
levels of IIC activities and the scheme of awarding points according to institute’s performance.
Road Safety Awareness Programme
A ‘Road Safety Awareness Programme’ for
students, staff and faculty members of IIIT-NR
was organized on March 24, 2023 by the Institute
of Driving and Traffic Research, Chhattisgarh, (A
joint venture between Transport Department,
Govt. of Chhattisgarh and Maruti Suzuki India
Ltd.). According to the World Health
Organization, globally road traffic crashes kill
about 1.3 million people and injure up to 50
million people every year. Road traffic injuries are
projected to be the fifth leading cause of death
globally by 2030. Part of the problem is the
explosive growth in the number of vehicles, exacerbated by high speeds and lack of adequate
infrastructure and regulations, especially in developing countries. The participants were told
about professional and scientific driving practices as well as healthy road safety habits.
Health-Checkup Camp
The Institute dispensary organized a health-checkup camp in the institute on March 24, 2023.
The camp aimed to promote awareness about health and well-being among students, staff and
faculty members of our institute.

Students Activity Centre and Clubs
IIIT-NR ensures that its students are not only
transformed into good engineers or professionals but also
good human beings so as to serve the society in better
ways to meet the aspirations of the citizens. Towards this,
for all round development of students, IIIT-NR has a
dedicated ‘Student Activity Centre (SAC)’ which is run
and managed by students of IIIT-NR.
The SAC aims to support, develop and promote students
activities at IIIT-Naya Raipur to enhance their aesthetic,
invasive, artistic, intellectual, and social development. It
organises various seminars, expert talks, professional
and skill oriented competitions, tech-fests, sports and
games, extra-curricular activities and outreach programmes. All these programmes are
organised by various students’ clubs under the SAC. These clubs are divided into the following
four verticals:-
 Technical and Entrepreneurship
 Games and Sports
 Art and Culture
 Social Service and Upliftment
 Technical and Entrepreneurship
The technical clubs under SAC promote hands-on and
cooperative learning and also engage students in problem-solving
and higher-order thinking. They regularly conduct workshops,
seminars, hackathons, technical competitions on coding, problem
solving, machine learning, circuits, and entrepreneurship for
sharpening skill-sets and capacity building of the students of IIIT-
NR. There are the following five students’ clubs who organise
technical events:-
TSOC (The Society of Coders) Club : The TSOC aims to foster a culture of coding at IIIT-
NR by hosting various events such as
hackathons, workshops, and coding
competitions. The club emphasizes
hands-on learning in a supportive and
interesting environment. It's a club that
welcomes everyone from first-time
coders to experienced veterans of the
trade.

AIML (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) Club : The AIML Club is focused on
helping individuals evolve from admirers of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
technology to capable developers. The club provides an opportunity to learn and build projects
from the ground up using open-source tools
such as TensorFlow and Keras, with a focus
on application development using Python.
Additionally, members have the
opportunity to participate in competitions,
hackathons, and even contribute to the
open-source technology they work with. As
we live in the internet age and now moving
towards the age of AI, this club is an ideal
place to learn, explore and develop AI-
based projects.
CipherCell Club : CipherCell is an official cybersecurity club at
IIIT-NR. The goal of the club is to raise awareness about hacking
and to dispel negative stereotypes associated with the field while
educating those who are interested in cybersecurity.
Inquizitive Club : True to its name, Inquisitive is the abode of the
most curious minds of IIIT-NR. Inquisitive brings current affairs,
and general knowledge to you in a fun way. Thus, contributing to
increase the IQ of the students in the campus. Inquisitive regularly
organises quizzes and competitions on various topics, from general
knowledge and trivia to specific subject areas such as history,
science, literature, and more. The club provides a fun and engaging
environment for individuals to learn while building camaraderie
and friendly competition with others.
ComEt Club : The main objective of the club is to bring together
like-minded individuals and find solutions to real-world problems
using the available resources. The club encourages members to
participate in idea-generating events and develop new and
innovative ideas.
 Games and Sports
Atharv is the sports club at IIIT-NR. It is responsible for organizing
and conducting sports and eSports events and competitions such as
basketball leagues, cricket, football, CS:GO Valorant and Fifa
tournaments.

 Art and Culture
Cultural clubs under the SAC, provide ways for students to explore and engage in activities
outside their academic studies. These clubs foster sense of community and belongingness,
which are important for students in technical fields who may spend much time working
independently. These clubs regularly organise programmes and competitions on Music, Art,
Dance, Photography, Debate, Discussions, Poetry and Drama. There are the following eight
students’ cultural clubs which organise art and cultural events:-
Indradhanush : Indradhanush, as the name suggests, is a club made
to add colors to the routine college life so that creativity follows right
behind logic, symmetry, and expression. Indradhanush is a cultural club
of the institute and is behind the beautiful artistic work behind every
event. This club works on the power of imagination and visualization
which is a primary requirement even while working with codes.
Capriccio : Capriccio is a music club under SAC that encourages students to become immersed
in the art and science of music.
ShutterBug : Shutterbug is IIIT-NR's official photography club.
This club intends to help interested students of photography to learn
about the fundamentals of this field. It provides a supportive
environment to students of IIIT-NR to share their knowledge and
passion for photography. The club also organizes photography
workshops and exhibitions.
Club De Theatre : Club De Théâtre is the drama club at IIIT-Naya
Raipur that encourages students to participate in dramatic presentations
such as skits, mime, plays, and street theatre. The club promotes the
culture of drama, comedy, and other related forms of performance
among the students. The club serves as a platform for students to
showcase their talents, develop their skills, and experience the joy of
performance.
Igniters : Igniters is a dance club that aims to create excitement and
energy through the art of dance. The goal of the club is to provide a
space for students to explore and express themselves through dance,
and to celebrate this art form together as a community. By joining
Igniters, students get the opportunity to develop their dancing skills,
share their passion for dance with others, and perform on and off
campus.
Cover to Cover : C2C is a literature club at IIIT-Naya Raipur that aims to promote the love
and appreciation of literature among its members. The club creates a nurturing environment that
encourages creativity and liberation by exploring different literary traditions and perspectives.

Take da Bait : Take da Bait is a debate club at IIIT-Naya Raipur.
The club's purpose is to provide a platform for students to discuss
and debate current trends and issues in the world, and to help
members form their own opinions on these topics. The club is
intended to help students connect to the changing socio-political
environment of the world and to understand the potential
advantages and disadvantages of technology and its impact on the

creatively, and to develop solutions to global issues.
